name: weekly_risk
decision: Which K assets to inspect next week, given a fixed inspection capacity
population: Assets with at least one recorded event before the validation window. Assets commissioned later are reported as coverage, not scored
zero_means: With observed=1, zero events means no recorded downtime. With observed=0 the asset was not operating or not monitored: excluded as a target and treated as missing in features

target.description: Downtime minutes in the target week, for observed asset-weeks only

forbidden: events or downtime of the target week
any window that includes the target week
fields corrected after the week ends
features.availability: Every feature is computed from weeks strictly before the target week

metric.name: capture_at_k
metric.description: Share of the week's downtime minutes, among scored assets, that falls on the K assets ranked first

owners.data: Owner of the downtime event log
owners.thresholds: Maintenance planning lead, with the ML team
